title: ToraOS: Four Research Papers and the Universal Semantic Constitution (Rev006)
description: Pre-publication metadata for the ToraOS research-document collection: P0 (2026-08-29), P1 (2026-08-30), P2 (2026-09-19), P3 (2026-09-28), and Universal Semantic Constitution Rev006. Tsubasa Nakagawa is the author name specified by him for all four papers; P1 author and date were confirmed by him on 2026-09-30 without changing the historical source body or translation. According to his statement on 2026-09-30, the ideas and conception of the four papers are his, while GPT composed and wrote their manuscript text. The exact GPT model IDs and drafting timestamps are unconfirmed. This statement concerns the papers and is not extended to the Constitution, whose original drafting model and scope of generated text remain unconfirmed. Historical AI-assistance statements in the source bodies are preserved unchanged. The papers are proposals and research drafts, not peer reviewed. Japanese originals are authoritative; English versions are translation drafts. P2 is included as a separate Japanese publication version masking only two private Drive links with an explanatory notice, while its source original is preserved unchanged in private preparation material. The author approved the identified personal disclosures and selected CC BY 4.0 for the texts on 2026-09-30. Private implementation and dialogue sources are not included and cannot be independently verified from this collection alone. AI use in translation and preparation is further disclosed in README.md. Preparing this file does not authorize public release or deposit. No collection publication date, release version, DOI, or ORCID is asserted.
